mechanism.claim: The standardized Asian-session USDKRW move minus the standardized USDHKD move removes common-dollar and currency-board pressure, isolating floating-won regional risk stress. In volatile BTC regimes, positive relative won stress maps short BTC and negative relief maps long BTC for twelve hours.
mechanism.side: opposite the strict sign of USDKRW z-score minus USDHKD z-score
mechanism.why_distinct: HPPRR used the raw USDHKD peg-pressure move; MXRBR used raw USDMXN; EMDFR used a three-country common dollar median and failed before events. APWSR is a two-market relative-value spread that subtracts the peg leg, reuses no prior event set, and promotes no control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: completed pre-decision 24-hour BTC realized variation must rank in its causal upper 35%
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: one sparse weekday 08:05 UTC external relative-FX clock is absent from Gross9 primitives

features.fx_session: bars_polygon 1m USDKRW and USDHKD rows with 00:00<=UTC time<08:00 on one weekday
features.session_valid: each pair has at least 450 distinct minutes, first<=00:05, last>=07:55, finite positive coherent OHLC; no imputation
features.pair_returns: session log close/open for each USD-local-currency pair
features.pair_zscores: each return standardized against its own at most 90 strictly prior valid sessions, minimum 60, current excluded; positive prior sample std
features.relative_won_stress: USDKRW z-score minus USDHKD z-score; strict nonzero
features.stress_abs_rank: strict-prior midrank of absolute relative stress over at most 90 prior jointly valid sessions, minimum 60; rank>=0.70
features.btc_realized_variation: sqrt(sum squared completed-hour BTC returns over 24 hours ending at decision)
features.volatility_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 90 valid decision days, minimum 60; rank>=0.65

clock.decision: exact weekday D 08:00 UTC after both FX sessions and BTC variation complete
clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding_oi_premium: not signal inputs; exact funding only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.execution_price: sealed until source and novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: peg-adjusted relative regional FX stress transmission

stopping_rule: Terminal first failure; no pair set, spread, rank, side, clock, session, hold, subset, or control repair
